stem.text: Which sequence of events could lead to mass flow in a phloem sieve tube?

items: Sucrose moves into a sieve tube element.
Protons $(\text{H}^{+})$ and sucrose molecules move into a companion cell through a co-transporter protein.
A very high hydrostatic pressure is produced.
The water potential of the sieve tube element decreases.
Protons $(\text{H}^{+})$ are actively pumped out of a companion cell.
Water moves down a water potential gradient by osmosis.
